name: viral-engine-v2
description: Rebuild of the short-form video system. The old one (n8n `FYNbtG0oHGWiDI2g`) treated a video as a list of assets glued to a voice track and produced a slideshow. This one models a video as **layers composited on a timeline** and copies the **form** of a reference — pacing, shot grammar, graphic vocabulary, grade, caption style — never its content.
